_comment: Consortium Core shop catalogue, starter file (docs/CONSORTIUM_CORE_V02.md section 5.4). Every price here is a PLACEHOLDER for the price-table step; PROGRESSION 3 (chunk loading) and PROJECT_RULES 4.1 and 4.2 (paid chunk loaders and claim extensions as money sinks) state no number. Chunk loaders are sold from phase 3 (PROGRESSION 3 and 6): the consortium:phase_3 stage, which also locks the items. The daily limit resets at 00:00 UTC, not at the 06:00 season day. Entry fields: name (1..48), description (<= 96), item {id, count, components} or command ({player}, {uuid}, {tx}; FTB Chunks takes an EntityArgument.player(), which refuses a UUID selector (it flags includesEntities), so the buyer is addressed by {player}, a name the mod validates against [A-Za-z0-9_]{1,16} before rendering), icon (required for command entries), price (credits, 2 decimals), daily_limit (1..999), stage, phase.

claim_chunks_10.description: Permanently raises your FTB Chunks claim allowance by 10 chunks
